reviews.text: We are new to Come Play Stay Toronto; it was a great find! Our dog is young and a bit shy but comes home bouncy and happy. She has also had a 2 night sleep over/boarding experience and it went really well.

Love that they provide real care for the dogs - it's obvious when you see how they interact with the pups.  Having a live video feed is great when I want to see what my dog is up to.  My dog is anxious, so having the option for her to sleep in a room with a staff member was great.

I left my Mini Aussie with them for daycare, and I can say they are great! Awesome facility and great staff. Communication was easy throughout the process. Unfortunately, my dog was a bit stressed and couldn’t stay for the entire duration, but they did everything they could to help and make her comfortable. Highly recommend!
Excellent.   We trust them fully with our dog.   We also enjoy the report cards during boarding.   Our dog is very happy here for either daycare or boarding.

Come Play Stay is like a human kiddie day care for dogs. Supervised at all times, organized play, outdoor recess breaks, snacks, and meals. Sophie LOVES it there; seeing all her friends and new ones and seeing her people pals there too!!
We love the 'Report card' at the end of each day! They truly capture Sophie's personality and outline her day.  We feel safe leaving our fur baby in such good hands.
Thank you Come Play Stay for excellent, knowledgeable, and professional doggy Care; day care AND boarding.
I may be biased but CPS does doggy daycare different and we have loads of fun. Here's some pics 🥰 …
Absolutely love the daycare at Come Play Stay! And the new grooming is top notch. They did a fantastic job on our pooch.

This has been a great experience so far. The staff is lovely and knowledgeable. The facility is spotless, well staffed and attentive. Our dog is happy and very tired when she comes home. A tired Doggo is a happy Doggo. Would highly recommend this business. We are recent transplants back to Beach!

Jim Killoch and Thomas Howlett

We have had the best experience with Come Play Stay from the day of our’s and our dog Roo’s initial assessment visit.  Derek was fantastic and took the time to give us a full tour of the building and to support Roo to feel safe and comfortable.  The space, inside and out, is beautiful and thoughtfully designed to cater to different sizes and temperaments of dogs - it was and has consistently been clean, despite the constant dog activity. Derek answered all of our questions (there were many as anxious dog parents looking for a good daycare/boarding experience for our Korean rescue).  Roo had her first weekend of boarding this past weekend, and, similar to the day care, the daily report cards with photos were detailed, thoughtful, informative, comprehensive and so reassuring.  In conclusion, we have complete confidence in Derek and the team and could not be more happy to give Come Play Stay our highest recommendation.

Roo had her first ever grooming session at Come Play Stay yesterday. We are so impressed! Charlie, the groomer, did an excellent job and Roo looks fantastic! Roo is a nervous girl and we were concerned she might not tolerate the grooming but Charlie rose to the challenge and was patient and  sensitive to Roo’s needs. Charlie did a fabulous job and Derek, of course, was a calming and supportive presence. We highly recommend CPS for grooming, daycare and boarding.

I am so happy to have found Come Play Stay! They have a bright and clean building and the team are caring and playful with my dog. I get pictures and a report on each visit which is not only informative but tells me they know my dog. Amazing!🤩 …

We have tried a couple of other boarders and Come Play Stay is by far the best one. Our dog is anxious and a picky eater and the daily report card and pictures really eased our minds.
A shout out to all the staff 😅😊 …

This place has been great for boarding my dog.  Has stayed twice now.  Most recently a long stay of 2 weeks.  Got him back injury free and healthy both times.  No crates or lock up kennels for dogs here.  They get to walk around freely and play with staff that enjoy the company of dogs! Sleep in their own bedding which can be provided!  Highly recommended if you care about your dog and want him returned to you healthy and happy!  They also provide daily report cards with pictures which is great!

We absolutely love this doggy daycare! The staff are incredibly kind, caring, and attentive — you can really tell they adore the dogs they look after. We always feel completely at ease leaving our pup here, whether it's just for the day or for overnight boarding. The environment is clean, fun, and full of positive energy, and our dog gets plenty of playtime, attention, and love from both the team and all his furry friends. It means the world to know he’s so well cared for. Highly recommend! 🐾❤️

We couldn’t recommend Come Play Stay enough. We were nervous leaving our four-month-old puppy, Ollie, for nearly two weeks, but the team took such incredible care of him and quickly put us at ease.

We genuinely looked forward to his daily report each evening and loved seeing how much fun he was having. It’s clear the team truly cares about the dogs in their care—Ollie came home happy, healthy, and well loved.

The daycare and staff are incredible! I walk away after a drop off with peace of mind, knowing that our girl is in very good hands. She absolutely loves going there and has made so many friends at the daycare. In addition, the live WebCam,, photos and report cards  provided for the sessions on the app are such a wonderful extra touch. If you need a daycare and are considering CPS, don’t hesitate. Just do it.

I am so glad I found Come, Stay, Play for my four year old miniature poodle. He was a rescue and highly anxious, but with the wonderful staff at Come, Stay, Play.. he has found his happy place. He is so much more relaxed around people and other dogs thanks to this safe, warm and loving environment. 🐾❤️ …

Due to a not so great experience at a previous daycare, I was so nervous to have my rescue dog Giggles try a different daycare. I heard good things about Come Play Stay and decided to give it a try. When I met Derek for our assessment, he put my mind at ease by explaining that they worked with other rescue dogs in the past that have joined their pack. Giggles has now been going for months to this daycare and she is always excited to be there . Everyone who works there is an animal lover and knows how to handle different dogs and their unique personalities.  I love that every day you get a report of what you dog was up to during daycare hours. I am so happy to have found Come Play Stay. Thank you for all the love you pour into the dogs you look after every day.

Cannot recommend more highly. Found this day care when I was looking to board my dog for a longer stay and now I have to take him back a couple times a week because he loves it too much.

Staff are 10/10 and they have the best Report Cards :)
Our yellow lab absolutely loves going to Come Play Stay. She comes home exhausted from playing with her friends all day, and the staff take such great care of her (non-stop fetch). Thank you guys!

Our 4 year old Bully cries and whines once she sees the building in excitement and anticipation. We have done daycare and boarding and can’t say how comfortable we feel dropping our big baby off. She’s a big strong ball of energy who loves dog and human attention, which luckily is welcomed. Highly recommend.

I just had to board my two very shy, very sheltered rescue dogs and Come Stay And Play we’re just fantastic. The dogs came home very happy their skin softer than ever. I asked them to treat my babies with cream because they have dry skin from when they were neglected. They did a great job of caring for them. I can’t say how fantastic this place is without recommending to everybody if you need to board your dogs overnight or even just for the day, this is the place. And another added bonus as you can. Watch them on video. Thank you, Holly  Dale.

Our dog Blue (4 year old husky mix) loves this place! We live in the neighbourhood and he always tried to drag us in 😂 We have used both their daycare and boarding services a few times since they opened and we have been happy with every experience! The facility itself is clean and new, the staff are friendly and helpful, the prices are great and as a Beacher, you can't beat the location! Specifically, we love that they offer non-crated overnight options, the personalized/detailed daily report cards, that they now have cameras available, their low staff-to-dog ratio (have used other boarders who are way too understaffed and overbooked aka. your dog doesn't don't get much attention or proper supervision) and the backyard space that is used frequently throughout the day. Overall, we would definitely recommend Come, Play, Stay for your dog(s)- you'll both love it ☺️

I can’t say enough super things about CPS daycare & boarding!   Derek,Julia, Austin, Axel, Travis & anyone I’m missing are the most caring, professional and knowledgeable dog care givers hands down.
Our Pico has been going since he was a smaller puppy over 6 months ago and loves the people, his dog friends and the great open spaces CPS provides.
I absolutely trust putting our boy in their care and they give the greatest report cards and update pictures each day.
It honestly puts me in a good mood each time I go to pick up Pico & interact with the staff.
Absolutely 5 star service & care, highly recommend for daycare & boarding!
Our dog had the best stay.  The comfort we had with getting pictures and report cards while we were away. And the fact we could see her anytime on the webcams was amazing. We will definitely be back!

So happy I came across this doggy boarding/doggy daycare place. From when we first reached out, they were very responsive! I previously reached out to about 5 other places in the area and didn’t hear back from 1/2 of them, but this place responded within the day! We went in for our initial assessment, and I was really impressed with the space, you almost wouldn’t think dogs didn’t live there lol - it smells like spa!! The have many spaces for the dogs, indoor and out.  We had our doggy do 1/2 day of daycare to prep for his 9 day stay that ended up being 12 days!! The team at Come Play Stay was AMAZING!! So accommodating to our travel plans (our flight was cancelled) and just so loving to our furbaby. It’s hard for my to trust just anyone with my baby but CPS has my trust! He loved his time there. I loved loved loved the report cards. It was my husband and I’s highlight of our days way reading it and seeing the pictures, also check instagram for bonus pics. Also, they have an app which makes booking and seeing report cards super easy!! All in all, we had such a positive experience here and will definitely use them again! Highly recommend! :)

Wonderful experience! They were incredibly accommodating, very responsive, and communicated clearly throughout my dog’s stay. I loved receiving regular photos and updates, and everything felt professional and well-run.

Come Play Stay is our trusted petsitter! Our pup loves his weekly visits to socialize with other dogs and get some energy out, whether it's a yappy hour, a half day, or a full day of fun. He is always well taken care of, well loved, and well exercised! The daily report cards and live cameras are great ways to check in when we're missing our buddy.

My dog Reggie absolutely loves this place! The moment we pull up front, his tail starts wagging and he can’t wait to run inside. It’s such a relief knowing he’s in great hands, having the best time with his doggy friends. The staff clearly care about every pup, and the detailed daily report — complete with adorable photos — is the icing on the cake. I always feel confident he’s safe, happy, and well cared for here. Highly recommend!

My pup just loves going to see her friends at Come Play Stay. The staff are attentive and affectionate, and send daily "report cards" with photos and pet-specific behavior updates. The facility is clean and dog-safe and they have separate rooms in which they can segregate the dogs based on temperament, levels of energy and mood so the zoomies can zoom and the nappers can nap. They recently added a live webcam streaming feature so owners can check in on their dogs in real time throughout the day. Would definitely recommend.

We can't say enough good things about Come Play Stay! The facility is spotless, and the staff are friendly, professional and truly care about the dogs. Derek and his team are wonderful, they clearly love what they do!
Our dog Bennie is quite shy and timid, but he recently spent a week boarding there, and we had complete peace of mind knowing that he was being so well looked after, and loved.
The daily report card with photos was such a nice touch, and it was so reassuring to know that a staff member stayed overnight.
We highly recommend Come Play Stay to anyone looking for a clean, caring and fun environment for their pup.
Bennie will definitely be back soon 🐾
Every part of the experience was just perfect! They took care of everything and gave us confidence that our dog would be in good hands. Highly recommend!

Randall started having occasional boarding at Come Play Stay shortly after it opened.  He just had an extended stay while we were on a  longer trip and he enjoyed every moment. The staff are great and the daily report cards with pics are nice to get each day. The facility is new and clean, it’s nice to have a place to board your pet and feel comfortable that he/she are being well taken care of and are having a great time.
Great place to board our dog in the neighbourhood! I’m so glad there is a place we can bring her that’s so convenient for us. Staff are very kind and I love the report card at the end of the day!
Zelda loves her visits to Come Play Stay.  She has so much fun and the care is amazing.

I boarded my dog Mia for the first time at Come play stay. I was blown away by everything and everyone involved in my girl's care. She had so much fun. There was water play, rest time, enrichment,  individualized feeding routine, so much more. My favorite part was the daily report card with photos. Thr care team picked up on all of my dog's quirks. I truly felt completely at ease leaving my spoiled girl in their capable hands.

Boy am I grateful that Come Play Stay is my (extended) neighbourhood ...they are fantastic temporary home for Tashi, our family dog!

One afternoon while driving home from running errands in the Beaches, my sister and I noticed Come Play Stay and decided to contact them. Derek was quick to respond to our query and invited us over for an assessment. We were happy with the assessment and in the process also got to meet & pet other boarders/day care residents :).

In the weeks after the assessment, we prepped Tashi by dropping her off for half day day care sessions and an overnight boarding before dropping her off for an extended stay of 11 days.

Boarding especially for first time dogs and their humans can be hard, the guilt for humans and anxiety/uncertainty for dogs is very real. However Derek and team (Julia, Katelyn & Kari) are exceptional...whether its implementing tips and tricks to get my dog to eat, tending to her at night while sleeping or organizing activities for her during the day they look into every aspect of care of our furry family members.

The Report Card with updates of day and night (and photo & videos) is what my family looked forward to every day. I would read them at ~10 pm at night and update my parents during breakfast the next day.

In addition to the above, I also emailed the team frequently for additional queries and they have ALWAYS been quick to respond.

For all the above reasons and more, I am so grateful that we came across Come Play Stay.

5 Stars - A second home for our sensitive Vizsla Coco

We are beyond grateful for the care our nearly 5-year-old Vizsla, Coco, receives at this amazing place — both during her weekly daycare visits and her boarding stays.

Coco is a sensitive, deeply attached dog who has never been boarded before discovering this gem. She had only ever stayed with family, and we were genuinely nervous about how she’d cope in a traditional boarding setup. But from day one, this place felt different.
Coco goes to daycare every single week and she absolutely loves it. She sprints through the doors with her tail wagging, excited to see her human and dog friends. It’s her happy place — and knowing that she’s excited to go makes all the difference for us.

When it came time to board her, we were still a bit apprehensive — but we shouldn’t have been. During her stays, Coco sleeps in a room with one of the incredible team members (thank you, Julia, for being such a calming, loving presence), and she continues to attend daycare during the day. This structure — companionship at night and play during the day — mirrors her routine and keeps her feeling safe, stimulated, and secure.

And the cherry on top? The daily personalized reports and photos we receive while she boards. Every update is thoughtful and detailed, full of joy and personality. It’s clear that the staff knows Coco individually and cares about her well-being just as much as we do.

Huge thanks to Derek, Julia and the entire team. You’ve given us a place we trust completely and, more importantly, a second home for Coco. She’s not just cared for — she’s loved. For any dog parent with an emotionally sensitive pup, this place is everything you’ve been looking for.

- Ana & Matt

Our big girl (Pyrenees/shepherd mix) loves going to Come Play Stay! It’s such a convenient solution for doggy day care and overnight care that feels like home. She is excited to go and has made lots of friends. The staff are fantastic and we get great updates and report cards.
My two dogs had a great time at Come Play Stay and were well taken care of. I appreciated the daily reports and photos. I would definitely use them again.
Thanks for the 5*!

I went back and forth about which doggy daycare to use for my girl Violet, and I’m so thrilled I went here. She has such an amazing time! The staff are knowledgeable, friendly and the booking app they use makes scheduling her visits a dream!

The hours are great and I know I will be using their boarding and grooming services in the future. I recommend them to everyone I meet and you will too!!!

Wonderful facility,  amazing humans! Our 9-month little bully has had an amazing  time at every visit.  We have used daycare and the boarding services here and can not say enough good things about this place. The individual care provided to each dog, regardless of  pack size, is top notch.  Leo comes home ready for a long nap and gained social skills with every visit!

Denise
My dog stayed the day and so far I'm pretty impressed. Cleanliness is a big deal to me after the dog's last place, and CPST was spotless.

I can’t say enough about Come Stay Play. The staff are amazing and the dogs have a blast. My pup can barely contain herself in the morning when I drop her off, as she is so excited to hang out with her canine companions. The staff are attentive and they are truly invested in ensuring the dogs have a great day. It’s a treat to read the daily report card. Top-notch service from a top-notch team!

What a gem Come Play Stay is for dogs and their family members. What a delight to find for our senior Labrador Emily.
We were happy to see the areas where she would be and found the facility clean and welcoming to both the two and four legged.
I appreciated that she was not in a kennel or crated and could nap or rest when needed.
The daily report while we were away was something we looked forward to and appreciated the photos/details about her day and nights.
All the reports were exactly our dog’s personality and accurate. I liked that the dogs were outside more on nice weather days.
The staff clearly love being with the dogs and were attentive answering any questions and emails.
Thankyou to your staff for giving us peace of mind knowing she was well cared for .Becky White

My dog boarded here for 5 days over March Break. The staff was amazing and the facilities also great. The dogs were outside and well supervised. When my dog was anxious sleeping at night they even offered to allow him to sleep on the staff member's bed. They really seem to care about the animals. We had daily report cards and pictures! These guys are great and highly recommend them.

We had a 5 star experience with Come Play Stay. Our dog has boarded with them twice so far for 7-10 day durations and he loved it. The team are really great with the dogs and communicating with the owners. I would recommend them to anyone.

My sweet boy Stevie had the best time here. So glad I found this place! The team has been SO lovely and caring of Stevie's needs. The daily report cards were so thoughtful and such a nice surprise to receive, i didn't worry one bit while i was away! Cant wait to bring him here again soon :)

Nessie was in the best of hands for a week of boarding at Come Play Stay! We received daily updates and photos in her “report card”. She was healthy and happy when we picked her up! Will be boarding with CPS again!

We're happy to share this review of our lovely puppy Polly's experience as Come Play Stay's inaugural boarder. We were very happy with the quality and competence of care that she received during her stay. It was a great peace of mind and heart for us, that we received daily reports and many photos of her activities and playtime, and to see how many new friends she was making, doggies and staffies alike. We were very grateful to see how comfortable she was. Our decision was also very much based on the fact that we knew someone was with her 24/7, providing care and a sense of security for her, and for us. We’re very happy to know that when such needs will come again in the future, she will have a safe, secure and happy place to stay. Thank you to the great staff!
So lucky to have this place in our neighbourhood. Our pup, Teddy, always has the best time at daycare and boarding. Derek and the crew take the absolute best care of them.

Our Goldendoodle Kai had a great first day at Come Play Stay!
Lovely facility with very friendly staff. We will definitely be back as it's the perfect neighbourhood spot for Kai to burn off some afternoon energy while we're at work.

We were very happy when Come, Play, Stay opened at the end of our street since it gave us another option for high-quality, attentive and convenient care for our dog Bentley. Their online booking system is not only easy to use, but also flexible to our needs, and their long hours of operation accommodate early dropoffs, late pickups, weekend daycare, and boarding experiences too. From Bentley’s first morning, I knew he was in good hands, and receiving his daily report cards showed me that the employees understood his personality and preferences, and they responded accordingly. One day he was more extroverted, the next more introverted, and both times they gave him the space to be himself. Huge peace of mind for us and 2025 looks more positive for our family with this new relationship established.
